delivery.outcome: Reject malformed literal Git branch names in branch lifecycle observations before evaluating cleanup findings; retain valid Unicode and ordinary ticket branches.
nonGoals: No branch deletion, cleanup authority, or review policy change

architecture.decision: Extend the existing offline require_ref boundary for all three branch-name fields with Git literal branch syntax. Preserve the 255-character input bound and typed malformed-snapshot diagnostic. Validate against real Git in isolated test fixtures; do not execute Git or expand revision shorthand in the runtime checker.
interfaceChanges: Malformed branch names produce GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-003 before lifecycle evaluation.
architecture.rollback: Independent reviewed revert; preserve refs and immutable tags.

validation.evidence: Malformed default/list/PR refs and literal revision shorthands rejected; valid Git branch cases preserved; public CLI fails with existing malformed-snapshot code.
Native source checks and independent current-head approval precede merge.
